title: 第10章 全灭第11章 皇级武器神皇琴
content_zh:
圣君四人绕过蛊族老祖，直接杀入蛊族大军，继续着这一面倒的大屠杀！
其余四位蛊族老祖正想上前阻止，但被邪帝一人拦下。
“看什么看，你们五个打我一个。”
“乳臭未干的黄口小儿，先把你杀了！”
“杀我？你们也配？艾德士圣枪！复仇圣枪！”
一声龙吟，一柄银白色长枪现，枪上围绕着龙纹，神级武器——艾德士圣枪！
黑色的火焰复仇火焰攀附上圣枪，复仇圣枪！
艾德士圣枪，九天神国曾经的镇国将军艾德士上将的武器，但被小人联合奸臣所害而陨落，后续邪帝为其复仇，继承艾德士圣枪。
圣天一族的三位老祖已经看傻了，好像根本用不到他们出手。
“这什么情况，震云那小子哪找来的帮手？这些人的武器皆是神级！神级呐，在他们手里像烂大街的货一样。”圣天震云，就是圣天一族族长。
“不知道，但邪帝更强了。”圣天极剑缓缓的说道。
“弟弟，十年前就是他把你击败了？8岁？我还是不相信啊。”
“看看就知道了。”那位妇女说道，圣天丽华。
“圣枪突击！”面对蛊族五人，邪帝主动出击，速度极快。
“一个。”还没发现邪帝的影子，圣枪已至，一位蛊族老祖被圣枪穿头而过，脑浆四溅。邪帝现，没沾一滴血。
秒杀！是的，一招瞬秒一位神境巅峰的老祖！俩人修为都为神境巅峰，但邪帝居然做到了秒杀！
“就这？你们还是自杀吧，你们的神境水分是不是太大了啊？嗑药嗑的吧？”
圣天正锋倒吸一口冷气：“嘶——要是我来，我怕是不会那么轻易拿下，邪帝确实强。”
邪帝仅仅是一击便折服了圣天正锋。蛊族其他四位老祖还呆呆的看着，眼里充满了震惊。
“你到底是谁！”一位老祖大吼道。“蛊虫狂噬！”无数的蛊虫飞向邪帝。

“你们未入世，不听闻我之名也正常。幽冥火！”但被幽冥火吞噬殆尽，“很不巧啊，火正好克制你们啊。”
“一起上！”
“来的好，暗之国禁忌术——魔影身！”邪帝分身现，一模一样。邪帝将艾德士圣枪丢给分身。
魔影身，召唤一个分身可以一直存在，召唤俩个只能存在48小时，三个24小时，每多一个便少一半时间。但是分身完全听从本体的命令，拥有自我意识，不会说话。
实力与本体一样。但没有本体的体质。这就差不多等于俩个邪帝。
俩个邪帝，一人战俩个老祖。
“暗之国禁忌术——魔神！”邪帝释放魔神，为战神众人补充能量。
“一道分身而已，能有多强，别去管那道分身。”四人继续集火邪帝本体。
邪帝的分身受到了无视，感到很不爽，手握艾德士圣枪，出现在老祖身后，老祖转头，艾德士圣枪从上而下，直接将那老祖捅的一分为二。
“这招叫斩立决！无视我的分身，针不戳啊。”但是分身也因溅到了蛊族之血而被腐蚀消失。
“还有三个，我还以为有多强呢。记住了，斩了你们的人叫邪帝！”邪帝收回艾德士圣枪。
“居然敢称帝！好大的胆子！蛊虫，我的小宝贝们，赶紧吞噬他，啊啊啊啊啊！”
“暗血剑！复仇圣剑！”复仇火焰加持在暗血剑之上。
“佛心剑法，一叶一轻舟！”刹那间，好似有好多小舟撞向港口，一往无前的浪吧。
“幻影剑法，剑光肆意！”无数剑芒疯狂闪过。
content_en:
The four Saint Lords bypassed the Gu clan ancestors and charged directly into the Gu clan army, continuing this one-sided massacre!
The remaining four Gu clan ancestors were about to step forward to stop them, but were stopped by the Evil Emperor alone.
"What are you looking at? Five of you are beating me up."
"You little boy with a yellow mouth, I'll kill you first!"
"Kill me? Do you deserve it? The Holy Spear of Edes! The Holy Spear of Vengeance!"
With a dragon's roar, a silver-white spear appeared, with dragon patterns surrounding it, a god-level weapon - the Holy Spear of Edesh!
The black flame of revenge clings to the holy spear, the holy spear of revenge!
The Holy Spear of Ades was the weapon of Admiral Ades, the former general of the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom, but he was killed by villains and traitors and fell. Later, the Evil Emperor avenged him and inherited the Holy Spear of Ades.
The three ancestors of the Shengtian clan have been dumbfounded. It seems that there is no need for them to take action.
"What's going on? Where did that kid Zhenyun get the help? These people's weapons are all god-level! God-level weapons are like trash in their hands." Shengtian Zhenyun is the leader of the Shengtian clan.
"I don't know, but the Evil Emperor is stronger." Shengtian Jijian said slowly.
"Brother, he was the one who defeated you ten years ago? At 8 years old? I still don't believe it."
"Just take a look and you will know." The woman said, Shengtian Lihua.
"Holy Spear Attack!" Facing the five Gu clan members, the Evil Emperor took the initiative and attacked at an extremely fast speed.
"One." Before the evil emperor's shadow could be found, the holy spear had arrived. An ancestor of the Gu clan was pierced through the head by the holy spear, and his brains were splashed everywhere. The Evil Emperor appears without a drop of blood.
Instant kill! Yes, one move instantly killed an ancestor at the peak of the divine realm! Both of them were at the peak of the divine realm, but the Evil Emperor actually managed to kill him instantly!
"That's it? You'd better commit suicide. Are your levels of water in the divine realm too high? Are you taking drugs?"
Shengtian Zhengfeng took a breath of air: "Hiss - if I come, I'm afraid I won't win so easily. The Evil Emperor is really strong."
The Evil Emperor subdued Shengtian Zhengfeng with just one blow. The other four ancestors of the Gu clan were still watching blankly, their eyes full of shock.
"Who the hell are you!" an ancestor yelled. "The Gu Insects are gnawing wildly!" Countless Gu Insects flew towards the Evil Emperor.
"It's normal for you not to have heard of my name before entering the world. Netherworld Fire!" But you were swallowed up by the Netherworld Fire. "What a coincidence, the fire just restrained you."
"Come together!"
"Well done, the forbidden technique of the Kingdom of Darkness - Demonic Shadow Body!" The evil emperor's clone appeared, exactly the same. The Evil Emperor threw the Holy Spear of Edesh to the clone.
The shadow body can exist all the time if you summon one clone. If you summon two clones, they can only exist for 48 hours. If you summon three clones, they can only exist for 24 hours. Each additional clone will shorten the time by half. But the clone completely obeys the orders of the main body, has self-awareness, and cannot speak.
The strength is the same as the original body. But there is no ontological constitution. This is almost equal to two evil emperors.
Two evil emperors, one fighting two ancestors.
"The forbidden art of the Kingdom of Darkness - Demon God!" The Evil Emperor released the Demon God to replenish energy for the God of War and others.
"It's just a clone. No matter how strong it can be, don't worry about that clone." The four of them continued to gather the body of the Fire Evil Emperor.
The Evil Emperor's clone felt very unhappy at being ignored. He appeared behind the ancestor with the Holy Spear of Edesh in his hand. The Ancestor turned his head, and the Holy Spear of Edesh came down from above and stabbed the ancestor in two.
"This move is called Zhan Lijue! Ignore my clone and don't poke it with the needle." However, the clone was also corroded and disappeared due to being splashed with the blood of the Gu clan.
"There are three more. I thought they were so powerful. Remember, the person who killed you is called the Evil Emperor!" The Evil Emperor took back the Holy Spear of Edesh.
"How dare you claim to be emperor! How brave! Gu worms, my little darlings, hurry up and devour him, ahhhhh!"
"Dark Blood Sword! Holy Sword of Vengeance!" The flame of revenge blessed the Dark Blood Sword.
"Buddha's Heart Sword Technique, one leaf, one boat!" In an instant, there seemed to be many small boats crashing into the port, and the waves were moving forward.
"Phantom Sword Technique,The sword light is wanton! "Countless sword lights flashed crazily.
